transitions.name: login/unlocked
transitions.evidence: The isolated provider read the provisioned key before lock.
transitions.limitation: This is the current logged-in, unlocked user session.

transitions.name: lock
transitions.evidence: The isolated keychain was locked; the provider failed closed and Writer emitted KeyUnavailable.
transitions.limitation: The probe locks an isolated Keychain, not the display lock or another user's session.

transitions.name: sleep
transitions.evidence: No positive claim is made; this transition is recorded as an explicit no-go.
transitions.limitation: Screen sleep is not triggered automatically because it suspends the active device session.

transitions.name: wake
transitions.evidence: No positive claim is made; this transition is recorded as an explicit no-go.
transitions.limitation: Wake requires a preceding interactive sleep transition and is not triggered automatically.

transitions.name: fast-user-switch
transitions.evidence: No positive claim is made; this transition is recorded as an explicit no-go.
transitions.limitation: No second authorized interactive user session is available for this run.

transitions.name: logout
transitions.evidence: No positive claim is made; this transition is recorded as an explicit no-go.
transitions.limitation: Logout would terminate the harness and cannot be safely automated in this run.

transitions.name: launchd-restart
transitions.evidence: No positive claim is made; this transition is recorded as an explicit no-go.
transitions.limitation: No GHOSTRACE launchd helper is enabled; restarting an unrelated user service is out of scope.
